info.name: Run a search against a chosen engine

params.name: engine
params.description: Search engine to query. SearchApi supports 100+ engines. Common values include `google`, `google_maps`, `google_news`, `google_scholar`, `google_images`, `google_videos`, `google_shopping`, `google_trends`, `google_jobs`, `google_autocomplete`, `google_lens`, `google_ai_mode`, `bing`, `duckduckgo`, `yahoo`, `yandex`, `baidu`, `youtube`, `amazon_search`, `walmart_search`, `ebay_search`.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query. Supports engine search operators (e.g. `site:`, `inurl:`). For some engines this parameter carries the engine's primary input (e.g. a place query for `google_maps`).

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key. Optional here because authentication is normally supplied via the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header; provide it as a query parameter only if you are not using the header.

params.name: location
params.description: Geographic location from which the search is executed. Cannot be combined with `uule`.

params.name: uule
params.description: Google-encoded location string. Cannot be combined with `location`.

params.name: device
params.description: Device type to emulate.

params.name: gl
params.description: Two-letter country code for the results (e.g. `us`, `gb`).

params.name: hl
params.description: Two-letter interface language code (e.g. `en`, `es`).

params.name: lr
params.description: Restrict results to documents in a given language, in `lang_{code}` form (e.g. `lang_en`).

params.name: cr
params.description: Restrict results to documents originating from a given country.

params.name: safe
params.description: SafeSearch filtering level.

params.name: nfpr
params.description: Set to `1` to exclude results from auto-corrected queries.

params.name: filter
params.description: Set to `0` to disable the "Similar/Omitted results" duplicate filters.

params.name: verbatim
params.description: Force exact-keyword (verbatim) matching.

params.name: kgmid
params.description: Knowledge Graph entity id (`/m/` or `/g/` form) to fetch a specific entity.

params.name: time_period
params.description: Restrict results to a relative time window.

params.name: time_period_min
params.description: Custom time-window start date, `MM/DD/YYYY`.

params.name: time_period_max
params.description: Custom time-window end date, `MM/DD/YYYY`.

params.name: page
params.description: Results page number.

params.name: ll
params.description: GPS coordinates for engines that accept them (notably `google_maps`), in `@latitude,longitude,zoom` (e.g. `@40.7455096,-74.0083012,14z`) form.

params.name: optimization_strategy
params.description: Request optimization approach.

params.name: zero_retention
params.description: Disable logging/storage of the request and response (Enterprise plans only).

items.docs: Executes a real-time search on the engine named by `engine` and returns structured JSON. The set of accepted parameters and the populated response blocks depend on the selected engine; the parameters below are those common to the Google web-search engine (the reference engine). See the per-engine docs pages for engine-specific parameters (e.g. `ll` for `google_maps`).
